question: Should ClawHub/OpenClaw still support the legacy `molt.bot/install.sh` installer, or should it be redirected or retired in favor of maintained CLI install paths?
rationale: Current main has maintained ClawHub install surfaces but not the hosted legacy installer source, so automation cannot infer ownership or patch scope safely.

options.title: Retire or redirect legacy installer
options.body: Point the old hosted URL to maintained install guidance and document the supported ClawHub/OpenClaw commands and Node range.

options.title: Support the legacy installer
options.body: Make the installer source traceable in an owned repo and fix the unmatched zsh cleanup glob with macOS/Homebrew coverage.

options.title: Wait for reporter update
options.body: Keep the issue waiting on author until there is fresh environment detail proving the current supported install path is still blocked.

recommendation.title: Retire or redirect legacy installer
recommendation.body: Point the old hosted URL to maintained install guidance and document the supported ClawHub/OpenClaw commands and Node range.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-history owner for the maintained CLI/package surface and already appears in the issue timeline.
